# make

Build targets from makefiles through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/make

moonx cli/make -f Buildfile -j 2 all

moonx cli/make -n all
```

Evaluate supported rules and variables, check dependencies and execute recipes through the owned shell. -j schedules ready recipe chains.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f VALUE`, `--file VALUE` | Select a makefile. |
| `-C VALUE` | Change working directory. |
| `-n`, `--just-print` | Print recipes; recursive and `+` recipes still execute. |
| `-B`, `--always-make` | Force rebuilding. |
| `-j[VALUE]`, `--jobs[=VALUE]` | Run up to N recipe chains; bare -j allows all ready targets. Default: `1`. |
| `-k`, `--keep-going` | Continue independent targets after failures. |
| `--help`, `-h` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

- The supported GNU make subset includes secondary expansion and selected jobserver behavior, not the complete language or every jobserver transport.
- -n can still execute recursive and plus-prefixed recipes. External commands require launcher permission; unsupported submake jobserver inheritance falls back to serial execution.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
